breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The internal axial force should vary segment by segment due to the applied loads,' directly contradicting the flawed instruction that treated the internal axial force as uniform along the full length. This aligns with the ground truth approach of analyzing each segment independently.
